name: Tughlaq | 2TC
author: Jockxtar

notes: 6 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ -> @resource/berrybush.webp@
Starting @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ -> @resource/berrybush.webp@
Make 1 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ and send it to scout for @resource/sheep.webp@ around @resource/resource_gold.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ -> @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (1st @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@@abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/house.webp@)
When @building_economy/house.webp@ is about to finish, position second @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ near @resource/resource_gold.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ -> @resource/sheep.webp@ (4)
Move 2 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and their @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ -> @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (11)
4 @resource/berrybush.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@+@unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ -> @resource/resource_stone.webp@
2 @resource/berrybush.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ -> @age/age_2.webp@
@landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@: Is better for the late game but barely noticeable in the early game. Strong but risky.

@landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@: @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ on @age/age_2.webp@ are super strong, specially in the first few minutes of the game. This can help us defend until we recover the investment on the @building_economy/town-center.webp@. Much safer but worse scaling.
@resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ -> @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/house.webp@
8 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ -> @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Leave the 4 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to later build and upgrade @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ -> @resource/sheep.webp@ (20)
--- vs cavalry civs ---
1 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ -> @abilities/repair.webp@@building_military/barracks.webp@
Main @building_economy/town-center.webp@@resource/rally.webp@ -> @resource/resource_food.webp@
2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@@resource/rally.webp@ -> @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Research @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ and @technology_tughluq/elephant_economics_1.webp@

When you get 400 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, build @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ near your two @building_economy/town-center.webp@ with at least 2 empty tiles around it to build @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/farm.webp@.

Select @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ as the governor for this @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@. The passive @resource/resource_food.webp@ will help us fund the extra @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ production and eventually go to @age/age_3.webp@.
Prioritize upgrading it rather than building new @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@.

If the opponent is playing aggressive and forces you to make units in @age/age_2.webp@, build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and research the upgrades, otherwise you will soon start floating @resource/resource_gold.webp@
@landmark_delhi/house-of-learning.webp@: Offers excellent upgrades for our core units (the elephants).

@landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@: Since we are already playing very greedy with the second @building_economy/town-center.webp@, focusing on building and upgrading @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ is too greedy.
During age up make sure to build another @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ and assign @ability_tughluq/uch.webp@ as its governor for the discounts on upgrades.
Gradually build @building_economy/farm.webp@ and @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ to complete your economy.
Defend with an infantry army (@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ + @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@) and raid with @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@
Add a few @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@ to tank @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Production buildings:
2 @building_military/barracks.webp@ ; 2 @building_military/archery-range.webp@ ; 4 @building_military/stable.webp@ ; 1 @building_military/siege-workshop.webp@
@building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ governors priority: @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ (tier 3) followed by @ability_tughluq/uch.webp@ (tier 1). Then pick based on the situation:
@ability_tughluq/ajmer.webp@ if under inmediate threat or to help secure an exposed @resource/resource_gold.webp@ vein.
@ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ if you manage to grab some @resource/relics.webp@.
@ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ for a stronger cavalry army. Preferably leave it for later.
@ability_tughluq/multan.webp@ if you don't need/want the others. A bit unnecessary.

@landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@: Can generate up to 300 @resource/resource_food.webp@ and 300 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ per minute, which is incredibly useful for the ideal @civilization_flag/tug.webp@ army that requires a lot of @resource/resource_gold.webp@.

@landmark_delhi/palace-of-the-sultan.webp@: The only tier 4 governor effects that are worth are @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ for more resources and @ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ for a bit of extra health on cavalry or @ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ for more healing on @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@.
Since we have already built and upgraded @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@, we can discard that option.

@ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ only grants 15 more health compared to the tier 3 effect, so it's not really worth it, although it can be useful for a timing attack right after aging up; since we are skipping the several minutes it takes to build and upgrade the @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ (and the @resource/resource_stone.webp@ cost).

@ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ is ok, but nothing too crazy, and adding @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ is very expensive for the stats they provide. It's good to have a few of them, but investing an entire landmark to buff them is not optimal.

Prioritize: @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@(@age/age_4.webp@) -> @technology_military/biology.webp@ -> @technology_delhi/armored-beasts.webp@ -> @technology_tughluq/ballista_elephant_age4.webp@ -> @technology_tughluq/healer_elephant_age_4.webp@
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Production buildings:
3 @building_military/barracks.webp@ ; 10 @building_military/stable.webp@ ; 4 @building_military/siege-workshop.webp@ ; 1 @building_religious/mosque.webp@
